_about: The single source of truth for this platform: what it accepts and what we have learned about it. Every skill, job and script that makes or posts videos for it reads this file; put new findings here, not anywhere else. The publisher reads maxSeconds and cutSeconds: a longer video goes to this platform as a cut of its first cutSeconds, with a short fade out.
notes: The API refuses Reels over about 40 s on this account (rupload ProcessingFailedError, the container never finishes). Seen 2026-11-16; may lift as the account ages.
So the first 39 s must work alone: hook, the key idea and the payoff before 39 s; the mascot end card is cut.
The grid and feed show an early frame: the headline must be readable from frame 0.
No private or scheduled posts through the API.
